fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2026-03-23, Rs. 4,800 was debited from the account of the complainant through UPI after a collect request from an unknown UPI ID was approved. The time of the incident was given as 09:15 on 2026-03-23. The online submission was made by Nithin Balan (9000000470). Suspicion was reportedly directed towards Ajith Nathan, using the number 9000000297. Funds were reportedly sent to the account reference SYN-ACC-100045. Items referenced in the complaint: mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Suspect allegedly posed as an online buyer and requested payment approval.
fields.Keywords: UPI fraud, online payment, apartment complex, phone records, receiving account, morning, suspect, mobile number
